configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.displayName: Native (SDL2, all 5 renderers) -- the WASM twin / compat oracle
configurePresets.description: 32-bit native build (needs libsdl2-dev:i386). Builds the full renderer set with no -D flags: NOpenGLESDrv + XOpenGLDrv + OpenGLDrv/UTGLR (system GL) + SoftDrv + NullDrv (2.12.0 sensible defaults). Not static, so NOpenGLES + XOpenGL co-link fine (glad-clash guard is BUILD_STATIC-only). Builds in build-native/.

configurePresets.name: wasm
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O2 + DWARF + assertions. The everyday dev build — named stacks and readable errors while the engine still runs at a playable speed. Builds in build-wasm/. Run `source ~/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh` first (sets EMSDK). [wired in step 2.7b]

configurePresets.name: wasm-debug
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build: -O0, nothing inlined, every local live. Reach for it when the OPTIMISER is the suspect — a bug that shows at one -O level and not another is almost always undefined behaviour. Builds in build-wasm-debug/.

configurePresets.name: wasm-perf
configurePresets.description: Emscripten web build (-O3, no debug -> smaller/faster). Builds in build-wasm-perf/. [wired in step 2.7b]
